reviews.text: I booked Yellowknife tour for my family of 16 with Bowie. She’s professional and reliable. Excellent service. We received a great tour in Yellowknife during our 5-day aurora trip. Strongly recommend Qualitour for your next trip.

Great Service! Bowie Law did an excellent job working late hours in helping book the tour and coordinate dates, hotel selection and scheduling flights. Highly recommend if you would like to book tours - Team cares for you. Tour was good, clothing providing were a warm enough and everyone was able to watch Aurora Lights in Yukon on second day of tour - First day was cloudy conditions. Pickup and drop off was on schedule. Will book tour again in future.
Amazing 2 nights in Yellowknife thanks to the arrangement of Bowie from Qualitour and the Aurora Dream Tours team!

This northern lights chasing trip was beyond our expectations. We saw the northern lights two days in the row. We almost gave up the second night. The northern lights suddenly showed up near midnight. It was absolutely beautiful. The lights was dancing in the sky.
The net fishing experience was incredible too!

We booked two private transfers with Qualitour between Vancouver and Sun Peaks for a ski holiday. Unfortunately, both transfers were extremely unsafe and distressing, raising serious concerns about passenger safety and driver competence.

During the first transfer, two rows of seats in the van were covered in visible mould. The driver was unaware of this until we pointed it out. While this was addressed at our first stop, it immediately raised concerns about vehicle inspection and hygiene standards.

Once the journey began, the driver repeatedly over-corrected and drifted between lanes, triggering the lane departure warning every few minutes.
As we approached the Coquihalla Highway at night, in snowy conditions and limited visibility, the driver was travelling at approximately 130 km/h. After the vehicle skidded upon hitting snow, the driver still failed to reduce speed, despite repeated requests from passengers where further loss of traction of the vehicle occurred. This demonstrated a serious disregard for passenger safety. The driver also appeared fatigued, frequently yawning throughout the journey.

After the first transfer we contacted Qualitor to raise our concerns and request a safe driver. There was no apology or acknowledgement of the unsafe journey putting my family at risk. The reply was simply that they would assign a different driver.

The second transfer raised further concerns. When we contacted the driver the night before to confirm the pickup location, communication was extremely difficult due to limited English proficiency of the driver.
On the day of travel, the driver was unable to navigate independently and relied on passengers for directions, which further undermined confidence in the company’s safety standards and driver training. The driver also did not know where the windscreen washer button was in the vehicle leading to limited visibility whilst driving. I asked the driver to pull over and we assisted him in showing him where it was located and we cleaned the windscreen at the next stop. As per attached photo.

A private transfer service should prioritise safety above all else. Based on our experience, we cannot recommend Qualitour due to significant safety, vehicle maintenance, and driver competency concerns.

Jack Barnfather
The best travel agency to arrange Yellowknife tour

If I could give 10 stars, I would. I tried using the official visa website to apply for my China visa, and honestly, it felt like trying to solve a Rubik’s Cube while blindfolded and underwater. The amount of paperwork, legal jargon, and endless questions had me ready to give up and just become a monk instead.

Then I found Qualitour, and let me tell you — absolute lifesaver. The woman who helped me was incredible. She guided me through everything, handled all the forms, made sure every single detail was correct, and even called the Chinese consulate directly whenever I had a question.

It’s hands down the best $129 I’ve ever spent — worth every single penny. I even gave her a big tip because she made the entire process so smooth, I didn’t have a single stress headache.

If you’re in Canada and not Chinese (or even if you are and just don’t want to wrestle with government websites), do yourself a favor and call Qualitour. I’m sending them all of my business from now on.

Thank you again for making the visa process painless — you turned a bureaucratic nightmare into a five-star experience!

Extremely unhappy about the agent ,Connie at Richmond branch !!! I have booked a cruise package w/ flight&hotel through FB with her. Since she only concern about the money, she had none customer service, zero compassionate about clients need and dishonest work etiquette.  The next day what I received was the booking confirmation with a "transfer flight" booked! Who would expected a Hawaii cruise package will comes with a transfer + wait time total 13hrs instead of a 6hrs direct back to Vancoucer?? She knew we are travelling with a 2yrs & 6yrs old, I personally have checked theres direct flight available, or with shorter waiting time of transfer. She blamed the booking was made by the cruise company's AI system so she has no right to pick the time. After I spoke with the cruise co they confirmed that the booking was made by the travel agent which means Connie was lying!!! All she emphasis was the flight and hotel were generated by computer. The AD never mentioned it's a transfer flight , she never mentioned either before charging my credit card! But she claimed she has 10yrs experience then why didn't she notify me before the booking is firm? If she cares about the client she could have double checked before booking, or chose a shorter waiting time flight for a family with little kids. All she worries is how much she could earn from the margin to book the cheapest way, but definitely not a pleasant way for her client. Now she ruin my holiday!!! If I knew it's a transfer flight I WOULD NEVER book this trip. If you are a parents with young kids, you definitely know how I feel 😡 why the heck I need doubled the time to back home !!

Thank you so much for the excellent service from Bowie Law of Qualitour.  We had a wonderful and very relaxing vacation. 😄 We will definitely be back for future vacation and highly appreciated for Bowie's detailed arrangements. 🥰🥰🥰

My son needed a Visa for an upcoming visit to China. I'm in Ontario and had previously worked a travel company in Vancouver to get a China Visa for my son back in 2017. That company was very good but unfortunately no longer prepares Visa applications. So I chose Qualitour, and that turned out to be a great choice. I worked with Bowie throughout the process. She was extremely helpful in preparing the Visa application forms. She was very responsive to my questions via email and by phone, and completed the required paperwork accurately, and she
provided the right information to me and told me exactly what we needed to bring along to China Visa Service Centre. All-in-all this was a very positive experience, and made our visit to China Visa Service Centre in Toronto very effortless. I would encourage others requiring a China Visa application prepared use Qualitour - you won't regret it.
The qualitour team was fantastic from planning stages to the very last hour of the trip. Would definitely use them again.

We had 16 people in our group.  To help us save some money, Bowie helped us to arrange a 14 people shuttle plus a sienna van. So the cost can be a bit less than getting a bus.  On our way back from Whistler to the airport,  James, the shuttle driver, told us that we had a little bit of time, and if we wanted to do a restroom break.  We took on the opportunity and asked if we could stop by Shannon Falls, and the drivers agreed without charging us extra. (of course, we tipped him well because he's so nice. :) The drivers were supper nice, and very responsible. They made the two hour drive very pleasant.  We will definitely use their services again when we go to Vancouver.

I booked an Aurora tour to Whitehorse with them after doing an online search. The package on their website caught my attention so gave them a call. Their agent, Bowie Law was very clear about what the tour included and what were my options. She was also super helpful and responsive to all my questions by both phone and email. In general the booking went super smooth and I appreciate the advice that was provided. During the tour, their operator Arctic Range was full of friendly staff which gave me a great experience overall and helped me enjoy my trip to Whitehorse.

Luckily I did not have any emergencies or unforseen circumstances but they do provide you with an emergency line in case you need it.

Overall, I recommend Qualitour for an Aurora trip to Whitehorse. I had a pleasant experience with them. Using a travel agency is going to be pricier than doing the planning yourself but it is worth it if you don't want to deal with the bookings and trying to find the good operators over there. My trip was close to the holidays and even so everything went super smooth.

Service was good.

However, Beware! As a practice, they always try to fish some more money our of your pocket (on top of what you paid in advance to book the service) by citing delays in your arrival (as if you can come out of plane in flash after landing). They know you are tired of a long flight and it is in the middle of the night; so, you cannot afford to lose your ride to your town. As such, they start claiming that "now our driver will have to stay in Surrey for the night ... which is a $150 cost ... you should pay him at least another $100).
Highly recommend qualitour- super responsive, Van was clean with more than enough room and the driver was professional.
